_readme: OPTIONAL hooks - NOT installed by default because each one depends on software
that only exists on the author's machine. Paste the group you want into the
then edit the paths. If the target program is missing the hook just fails and the
session continues, but a failing hook on every start is noise - only add what you
Windows note: the installed settings.json uses absolute paths (install.ps1 expands
the __USERPROFILE__ token in settings.template.json). Do the same here.
1. local-bridge     - runs a Python script at session start to push session context
into a companion agent / dashboard. Needs that script.
2. wsl-chat-digest  - pulls a digest of your agent chat channel from a WSL CLI, so
the session starts knowing what was said while you were away.
Needs WSL + that CLI on PATH.
3. ollama-ip-sync   - keeps a local LLM endpoint pointing at the right WSL IP after
a reboot (the IP changes). Ships as scripts/update-cc-ollama-ip.ps1.
